comments.body: The work of this PR should be targeting the https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/tree/4.7-maintenance branch... as opposed to `master`.
Ah good to know - thanks for the clarification.

The `master` branch is moving towards the Fedora 5.0.0 release... and the functionality related to blank nodes and hash-URIs is currently correct in the `master` branch and the 5.0.0 release. 

Targeting the work of this ticket to the 4.7-maintenance branch will allow for the optional use of the hash-URI functionality in a non-breaking 4.7.3 release.

Andrew Woods :  Any preference for the name of the system parameter  ?  I was thinking something like:  

fcrepo.modeshape.skolemize-bnode-to-hash-uri=<true|false>
Looks good... will merge later this week giving time in case anyone else has comments.

renderedFields.description:
This task is a follow-on to:
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2108

In an attempt to make the impact of the above ticket optional, this task is to add a System Property configuration item that enables the fcrepo-2108 behavior, but by default leaves the behavior the same as prior to fcrepo-2108.
